metadata.title: LCHAI thesis artefacts: FuzzyArcLoss V2 histologic-pattern classifier, 150 ABMIL/Fuzzy-Choquet mutation-prediction checkpoints and per-slide TCGA-LUAD pattern probabilities

creators.name: Lima Reina, Servio Fernando
creators.affiliation: University of Fribourg, Department of Informatics

metadata.description: Companion deposit for github.com/slima2/lchai (folder oncology-xai/Thesis). Contains (1) the Artefact 1 CTransPath + FuzzyArcLoss V2 six-pattern classifier; (2) the 150 PyTorch checkpoints of the Chapter 6 benchmark (5 MIL conditions x 6 genes x 5 folds); (3) per-slide pattern_probs.npy for 687 TCGA-LUAD slides; (4) tile-level prediction CSVs for 336 slides; (5) the ANORAK tile index and the pred_class-to-pattern mapping; (6) a 6-slide sample of the per-tile 512-d CTransPath embeddings (the case-study slides of Chapter 6) illustrating the format of the full 38.6 GB set. Class index order 0..5 = micropapillary, cribriform, papillary, lepidic, solid, acinar. Third-party CTransPath weights and the 38.6 GB of raw 512-d tile embeddings are not redistributed; sha256 manifests are provided so they can be verified after download/regeneration. See README_deposit.md.
metadata.notes: Class index order 0..5 = micropapillary, cribriform, papillary, lepidic, solid, acinar (fixed by the trained weights, not alphabetical). Verify files with sha256sum -c MANIFEST_sha256.txt.
